## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design tenant-scoped PKI, rotation, and audit workflows in Vault.

- Per-tenant PKI domain and intermediate CA

```bash
vault write ns-<id>/pki/issue/tenant-<id>-client \
  ttl=10m ip_sans="10.0.0.0/24"
```
